Provides ''' 50% ''' resistance to arc damage. '''''' is an armor passive in ''Helldivers 2''. ==Description== ==Functionality== Upon dying, unless gibbed, the player will ragdoll and health is immediately restored to full. While not under the effects of a stim, vision will turn black and white and audio will be muffled. Revived players suffer a permanent bleed penalty, where their stamina will always be fully depleted and their health constantly drains. Health drains at a rate of approximately 20% per second, and the player can still take damage from enemies as normal. This last stand state ends when the player's health is fully depleted, whether from the health drain or from enemy attacks. ==Tactical Information== * This armor passive
